spans.s:
मौन n. (-नं) Silence, taciturnity.
 E. मुनि a sage, (who practises,) अण् aff.
मौनव्रत n. (-तं) A vow of silence.

मौनिन् mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि) Silent, taciturn.
 m. (-नी) An ascetic, a hermit,
a religious sage, one who has overcome his passions and retired
from the world.
 E. मौन silence, and इनि aff.
